title: ShadTable — Shadcn Data Table & Table Components
desc: A collection of composable table components for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table — data tables, server-side pagination, tree tables, pivot tables, editable grids, and more. Installed via the shadcn CLI, owned in your codebase.
h1: Table components for the parts of your app that a design system doesn't cover.
ogt: ShadTable — Shadcn Data Table & Table Components

title: Shadcn Table with Animated Icons — ShadTable
desc: A table with animated row-action icons for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Row actions built with Iconimate — motion-driven icons that animate on hover, focus, and click, wired to favorite, notify, archive, and delete.
ogt: Shadcn Table with Animated Icons — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Table Column Pinning — ShadTable
desc: A column pinning table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Excel/AG Grid–style column pinning: freeze columns to the left or right edge while the rest of the table scrolls underneath.

title: Shadcn Comparison Table — ShadTable
desc: A comparison table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Pricing plans as table columns — feature rows compare booleans and values across every plan, with the recommended plan's column tinted to stand out.

title: Shadcn Conditional Formatting Table — ShadTable
desc: A conditional formatting table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Excel-style conditional formatting: a small rule engine highlights cells, colors text, and re-colors badges based on the row data, not just a single value.

title: Shadcn Data Table (TanStack Table Example) — ShadTable
desc: A data table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table, with React and Vue source. A sortable, filterable, paginated table with a composable toolbar for column filters — filtering and sorting run entirely client-side via TanStack Table.
ogt: Shadcn Data Table (TanStack Table Example) — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Editable Table (Inline Editing) — ShadTable
desc: An editable data table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Click a cell to edit it inline. Edits validate on commit, apply optimistically, roll back on a simulated failure, and can be undone one at a time.

title: Shadcn Data Table Filter State — ShadTable
desc: A data table filter state pattern for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A normalized ActiveFilter[] array as the single source of truth for multi-select and date-range filters, keeping the toolbar, chips row, and columnFilters in sync.
ogt: Shadcn Data Table Filter State — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Data Table Filter Toolbar — ShadTable
desc: A config-driven data table filter toolbar for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A config-driven filter system — filters are generated from column.meta instead of being hand-wired per column, with an active-filters row derived from columnFilters.
ogt: Shadcn Data Table Filter Toolbar — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Grouped Table (Row Grouping) — ShadTable
desc: A grouped table with row grouping for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Orders grouped by category, with collapsible group headers and a live subtotal of each group's order amounts.

title: Shadcn Heatmap Table — ShadTable
desc: A heatmap table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Revenue by region and month, with each cell's background intensity mapped to its value — spot patterns across a matrix at a glance instead of reading numbers.

title: Shadcn Inventory Allocation Table — ShadTable
desc: An inventory allocation table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. An editable inventory grid with expandable batch detail and live formula columns — reorder point, days of cover, and suggested PO recalculate as you edit demand, lead time, or batch allocations.

title: Shadcn KPI / Summary Table — ShadTable
desc: A KPI summary table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A compact metrics table — current value, period-over-period change, and a per-row sparkline — for the kind of dashboard summary that sits above the fold.

title: Shadcn Table with Live Status Indicators — ShadTable
desc: A live status table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A service-health table where status and latency update live on a timer, with a pulsing indicator for actively-monitored states.
ogt: Shadcn Table with Live Status Indicators — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Master-Detail Table (Expandable Rows) — ShadTable
desc: A master-detail table with expandable rows for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Expand an order to reveal its shipping address and a nested sub-table of line items — a full-width detail row rendered directly beneath the row that owns it.

title: Shadcn Responsive Table (Mobile Cards) — ShadTable
desc: A responsive table that becomes cards on mobile for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A data table that transforms into stacked cards below a container-query breakpoint using pure CSS display overrides — no separate mobile component, no JS media query, no viewport dependency.

title: Shadcn Table with URL Params Filters — ShadTable
desc: A data table with URL search params filters for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A data table whose filter state is synced to URL search params.
ogt: Shadcn Table with URL Params Filters — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Pivot Table — ShadTable
desc: A pivot table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Dashboard-style analytics table — pick which dimension becomes rows, which becomes columns, and how to aggregate (sum, average, or count), recomputed from flat sales data.

title: Shadcn Production Dashboard Table — ShadTable
desc: A production dashboard table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A production-line dashboard combining conditional formatting, progress bars, and sparklines on one realistic dataset — a composition of existing primitives, not a new feature.

title: Shadcn Drag-and-Drop Reorderable Table — ShadTable
desc: A drag-and-drop reorderable table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Drag rows to reorder them, built on @dnd-kit/sortable rather than any table-specific drag logic.

title: Shadcn Table Resizable & Reorderable Columns — ShadTable
desc: A table with resizable and reorderable columns for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Drag a header's grip to reorder columns, drag its right edge to resize — the resulting layout is saved to localStorage and restored on your next visit.
ogt: Shadcn Table Resizable & Reorderable Columns — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Server-Side Sort, Filter & Pagination — ShadTable
desc: A server-side sorting, filtering and pagination table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Sorting, filtering, and pagination all resolved together on the server from one URL, instead of three separate demos — the way real dashboards actually work.
ogt: Shadcn Server-Side Sort, Filter & Pagination — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Server-Side Filtering Table — ShadTable
desc: A server-side filtering table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Filtering by column, resolved on the server the same way SSR Pagination resolves pages — every filter change is a real server request, not an in-memory slice.

title: Shadcn Server-Side Pagination Table — ShadTable
desc: A server-side pagination table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Only the current page's rows are ever sent to the browser — changing pages triggers a real server request instead of slicing an in-memory array.

title: Shadcn Toolbar Filter Table — ShadTable
desc: A toolbar filter table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A simple filter row above the table — dropdown selects and a search input, filters applied immediately. The 80% use case for filtering.

title: Shadcn Tree Table with Drag Reorder — ShadTable
desc: A drag-and-drop tree table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. The same department/team/employee tree, with rows draggable by a handle — reordering is scoped to siblings so a department can't be dropped inside a team.
ogt: Shadcn Tree Table with Drag Reorder — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Tree Table with Checkbox Selection — ShadTable
desc: A tree table with checkbox selection for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. The same department/team/employee tree, with a checkbox column that cascades selection to every descendant and reports indeterminate state for partial branches.
ogt: Shadcn Tree Table with Checkbox Selection — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Tree Table (Nested Rows) — ShadTable
desc: A tree table for nested rows for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A hierarchical table for nested data — departments, teams, and employees — with expand/collapse, sorting, and a search box that keeps a matching row's ancestors visible.

title: Shadcn Table Density Toggle & Export — ShadTable
desc: A table with a density toggle and export for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. One table, three modes: a compact/comfortable/spacious density toggle, CSV/Excel/PDF export, and a print-optimized view that ignores dark mode entirely.
ogt: Shadcn Table Density Toggle & Export — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Table Export to CSV & Excel — ShadTable
desc: A table with configurable CSV and Excel export for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A table whose Export button opens a dialog: filter by status, region, and date, pick columns and CSV or Excel, and see a live count of matching rows before downloading.
ogt: Shadcn Table Export to CSV & Excel — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Table — Export Selected Rows — ShadTable
desc: A table that exports selected rows for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A table with row checkboxes that exports only the selected rows to CSV or Excel. Selection persists across pages, with a page-level select-all and a "Select all" shortcut.
ogt: Shadcn Table — Export Selected Rows — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Table with Async Row Actions — ShadTable
desc: A table with async row actions for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Table row actions with animated icons that reflect real request state: a sync icon that spins while pending, Retry on failure, Undo for archive, and a confirm step for delete.
ogt: Shadcn Table with Async Row Actions — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Deployments Table — ShadTable
desc: A deployments table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A deployment history table like on hosting platforms: status with build time, environment, branch and commit, with filters for environment, status, branch, and date and live counts on every option.

title: Shadcn Logs Table — ShadTable
desc: A log explorer table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: a date range picker, multi-select level, service, and status filters, highlighted search, and expandable rows with the full event.

title: Migrate TanStack Table v8 to v9 (shadcn/ui) — ShadTable
desc: A practical guide to migrating shadcn/ui tables from TanStack Table v8 to v9: feature registration, row models, typing, sortFn, state, column pinning, and a checklist, with before and after code.
h1: Migrating from TanStack Table v8 to v9
ogt: Migrate TanStack Table v8 to v9 (shadcn/ui) — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Infinite Scroll Table — ShadTable
desc: An infinite scroll table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Loads the next page as you scroll with an IntersectionObserver sentinel, skeleton loading rows, inline retry on errors, and a sticky header.

title: Shadcn Excel-like Spreadsheet Table — ShadTable
desc: An Excel-like spreadsheet table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A1 headers, keyboard navigation, range selection, type-to-edit, copy and paste, and formulas such as SUM and AVERAGE that recalculate as you edit.

title: Shadcn Data Table — TanStack Table v9 Example — ShadTable
desc: A data table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table v9. Same sortable, filterable, paginated table as the v8 version, ported to v9 useTable/tableFeatures.
h1: Shadcn Data Table — TanStack Table v9
ogt: Shadcn Data Table — TanStack Table v9 Example — ShadTable

title: Shadcn Tree Table (Nested Rows) — ShadTable
desc: A tree table for nested rows for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A hierarchical table for nested data — departments, teams, and employees — with expand/collapse, sorting, and a search box that keeps a matching row's ancestors visible.

title: Shadcn Excel-like Spreadsheet Table — ShadTable
desc: An Excel-like spreadsheet table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A1 headers, keyboard navigation, range selection, type-to-edit, copy and paste, and formulas such as SUM and AVERAGE that recalculate as you edit.
